pages.title: The board
pages.text: Bounty boards stand in villages and cannot be crafted. Bounties appear on them: take one, bring what it asks before time runs out, and cash it in at a board for the reward.

pages.title: Rarity
pages.text: Bounties are common, uncommon, rare or epic. The rarer one asks for more and gives a better reward and more experience.

pages.title: Space bounties
pages.text: After landing on the $(l:space/planets/moon)Moon$(), $(l:space/planets/mars)Mars$(), the $(l:space/planets/asteroids)asteroids$(), $(l:space/planets/venus)Venus$(), $(l:space/planets/mercury)Mercury$(), $(l:space/planets/ceres)Ceres$() or $(l:space/planets/jupiter#io)Io$(), boards offer bounties and rewards made of those worlds' materials. Only someone who has been there can turn them in.

pages.title: Science samples
pages.text: Samples from $(l:space/planets/mars#phobos)Phobos$(), $(l:space/planets/jupiter#europa)Europa$(), $(l:space/planets/jupiter#ganymede)Ganymede$(), $(l:space/planets/jupiter#callisto)Callisto$() and $(l:space/planets/neptune#triton)Triton$() are paid in parts of the next step: plates for rocket heavy plates, titanium for tanks, schematics and thermal cloth.

pages.title: Bounty Board
pages.text: Found in villages. Ordinary bounties ask for Overworld goods, space bounties for planet materials.
